experience.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Owned backend development for Even Infinite's Hospital Pass, simplifying member access to partner-hospital services and increasing pass engagement by 65%+.
Designed an AI calling framework for clinical follow-ups using LLM-based report summarization, care-manager suggestions, and automated call flows, reducing manual follow-up effort by ~40%.
Built a reusable onboarding package for insurance providers and automated CI/CD workflows, reducing provider integration time from 6 weeks to 2 weeks.
Fixed recurring document re-upload failures across post-hospitalization workflows, restoring reliable generation of 300+ weekly forms for care managers.
Refactored high-traffic frontend modules to support parallel data loading, reducing render times by ~25% and improving page stability.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Built an automated vehicle onboarding flow with plate detection and dynamic step routing across a 15-screen workflow, reducing manual review effort by 60% and onboarding errors by 80%.
Redesigned delayed-order ticketing workflows with automated escalation states and operator actions, reducing cancellation-prone cases by 80%.
Migrated logistics map tooling to Google Maps and optimized usage patterns, reducing map-related operating costs by 25%.
Built a Python-based sync pipeline for ~1M support tickets, automating recurring ops workflows and eliminating 95% of manual sync effort.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
achievements: Migrated 200+ legacy JavaScript components to TypeScript and Redux inside a Next.js monorepo, reducing build-time errors by 40% and improving development velocity by 30%.
Built a production-safe Go SDK to stream multi-GB ZIP archives directly to S3, reducing transfer latency by 65% and cutting peak memory usage by 50%.
Developed a GPS ingestion service processing ~50k location events/sec with live monitoring dashboards, improving ETA prediction accuracy by 12%.
Refactored service-to-service RPC flows using goroutines and gRPC batching, reducing P95 latency by 95% at ~2k TPS.

experience.title: Backend Developer Intern
achievements: Scaled a Strapi-based ERM platform to support ~1k RPS by adding in-memory caching, optimizing SQL queries, and restructuring backend routes.
Containerized backend services with Docker and deployed them on AWS EC2 with RDS and S3, reducing CI/CD runtime by 75%.
Automated hosting and deployment setup with Nginx, Certbot, and reusable scripts, reducing manual configuration effort by 90%.
Redesigned React component boundaries and state flow, reducing unnecessary re-renders by 40% on frequently used admin screens.

experience.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Intern
achievements: Developed backend and dashboard flows for a Next.js platform used by the UP Commercial Tax Department, supporting high-volume public-service workflows with JWT and HTTPOnly cookie auth.
Optimized MSSQL workloads using indexes, stored procedures, and query restructuring, reducing latency on critical database paths by up to 95%.
Built automated PDF-based discrepancy report generation using PDFMake and Mammoth, reducing manual formatting effort by 60%.
Implemented WAF protections, API validation, and access-control improvements for sensitive government-facing workflows.
